proposals.title: Reduce Tool Execution Errors
proposals.description: Tool execution errors account for 167 failures. Consider adding retry logic, timeout handling, and better error reporting.

proposals.title: Session Recovery on Error
proposals.description: 5 sessions terminated by error. Implement session checkpoint and recovery mechanism.

proposals.title: Proactive Failure Monitoring
proposals.description: Total failures (204) exceed threshold. Set up alerting when failure rate exceeds 10% of sessions.
